summary: Backend and frontend add an order-creation + confirmation flow, but backend data model/persistence does not match the requested stable Order schema (field names/types differ and stable persistence across upgrades is not evidenced). Several additional, unrequested features were introduced (access control system, user profiles, admin token initialization, branding/footer changes).

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must define a stable Order model with fields: orderId, items[{name, unitPriceInr, quantity}], totalInr, minecraftUsername, upiUtr, createdAt (timestamp).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows an Order type, but it is not the required schema (different field names like id/buyer/upiRef/totalINR/timestamp and item fields product/unitPriceINR). Also, the diff does not show any `stable` type/vars for persistence across upgrades.

missing_requirements.requirement: Order persistence should not lose data across refreshes/subsequent calls (persisted in canister state).
missing_requirements.reason: While `orders` is stored in an actor variable, the diff does not show `stable` storage or preupgrade/postupgrade handling; persistence across upgrades is not evidenced. (Page refresh persistence is implied but not explicitly ensured beyond in-memory canister state.)

missing_requirements.requirement: getOrderById(orderId) returns an explicit 'not found' result and does not trap for unknown orderId.
missing_requirements.reason: Unknown orderId appears to return `null`, but the implementation is truncated and also includes `Runtime.trap` for unauthorized access; the requirement only specifies unknown IDs explicitly (not authorization), and the diff does not show a structured not-found result variant beyond `?` nor the full method behavior due to truncation.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced access control system with authorization mixins and admin/user permission checks, including actor initialization via secret token.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not ask for an authorization layer beyond existing Internet Identity usage for checkout; adding admin token initialization/permission system is extra scope.
evidence: frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts (session/url param persistence utilities for tokens)

hallucinated_features.description: Added user profile storage and a profile setup modal gating behavior (name collection).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on order persistence and order confirmation; user profile CRUD and modal flow were not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/changed site footer branding and external link (caffeine.ai).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested as part of the order persistence/confirmation feature set.
